title: Definitions
description: The glossary: the definitions of terms the other documents rely on.

DefinitionId.description: The stable handle for citing the definition.

Definition.description: A term, named by its id, with its specification and optionally the criteria deciding whether a concept is an instance of the term. A definition is refined over time by adding criteria. Schemas that extend it add properties.

Specification.description: The precise meaning of the term.

Criteria.description: Classification criteria deciding whether a concept is an instance of the term.

Criterion.description: One classification criterion, either including a concept or excluding it.

IncludeCriterion.description: A concept matching the statement is an instance of the term.

ExcludeCriterion.description: A concept matching the statement is not an instance of the term.

CriterionStatement.description: The heuristic a concept is matched against.

Prose.description: Markdown text. A reference to an entry or a glossary term is its id in double square brackets, [[Id]]: every [[ opens a reference that closes with ]], holds no brackets, and is not blank. The reference must name an existing id.
